Package org.geysermc.paletter.item.component

Interface ItemComponent

All Known Subinterfaces:
WireOnlyItemComponent
All Known Implementing Classes:
AllowOffHand, BlockPlacer, BundleInteraction, CanDestroyInCreative, Compostable, Cooldown, Damage, Digger, DisplayName, Durability, Dyeable, Enchantable, EntityPlacer, FireResistant, Food, FrameCount, Fuel, Glint, HandEquipped, HoverTextColor, Icon, InteractButton, KineticWeapon, LiquidClipped, MaxStackSize, MiningSpeed, MusicRecord, PiercingWeapon, Projectile, Rarity, RenderOffsets, Repairable, Shooter, ShouldDespawn, StackedByData, StorageItem, StorageWeightLimit, StorageWeightModifier, SwingDuration, SwingSounds, Tags, ThrowableItem, UseAnimation, UseModifiers, Wearable
public sealed interface ItemComponent permits AllowOffHand, BlockPlacer, BundleInteraction, CanDestroyInCreative, Compostable, Cooldown, Damage, Digger, DisplayName, Durability, Dyeable, Enchantable, EntityPlacer, FireResistant, Food, Fuel, Glint, HandEquipped, HoverTextColor, Icon, InteractButton, KineticWeapon, LiquidClipped, MaxStackSize, MusicRecord, PiercingWeapon, Projectile, Rarity, Repairable, Shooter, ShouldDespawn, StackedByData, StorageItem, StorageWeightLimit, StorageWeightModifier, SwingDuration, SwingSounds, Tags, ThrowableItem, UseAnimation, UseModifiers, Wearable, WireOnlyItemComponent
A custom item component, mirroring Bedrock's add-on JSON: one record per component, generated from the component model in data/model (creator docs plus what Bedrock Dedicated Server sends). Paletter compiles them to the wire format of each palette's protocol.

Documented but not generated:

  • minecraft:chargeable: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by UseModifiers (docs note: "Released without an experimental toggle in 1.20.30; renamed to minecraft:use_modifiers in 1.20.50.") (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:custom_components: not modelled: binds script custom components; needs a script module (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:damage_absorption: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:durability_sensor: server only: BDS accepts it but sends nothing to clients (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:hand_equippped: not modelled: misspelled duplicate page of minecraft:hand_equipped (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:render_offsets: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1 (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:seed: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by BlockPlacer (BDS message (data/bds/1.26.63.1/spec): "Use minecraft:block_placer instead") (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:use_duration: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by UseModifiers (the docs of minecraft:use_modifiers list a field use_duration) (Microsoft Learn)
  • minecraft:weapon: rejected by BDS 1.26.63.1; replaced by Damage, Cooldown, Durability (docs note: "use minecraft:damage to set attack damage, minecraft:cooldown for attack speed, and minecraft:durability for durability.") (Microsoft Learn)

Hand-written wire-only components, for fields with no add-on JSON source: see WireOnlyItemComponent.

1.0.0
